description: Keyword search over the latest 50 posts of a previewed profile (from preview_profile). Case-insensitive substring match; returns matching posts ordered by engagement. Requires a free Flux account; calling it asks the person to sign in where the client supports it, otherwise use continue_url from preview_profile.

query.description: Text to look for in the posts, 2 to 100 characters

name: preview_search_posts
title: Search previewed posts
